Take them out before they heal the enemies around them!|[[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]] dialogue on Wave 16 (Formerly, [[Intermediate Mode|Intermediate]])}} }} ==Description== The '''Living Experiment''' is an enemy that appears in [[Intermediate Mode|Intermediate]], [[Challenge Trials]] and Molten Arena [[PVP]] modes. It also appears in [[The Takeover Event]]. It has a high amount of health, a below average speed and a decent amount of defense. Additionally, when it first spawns, it is a boss enemy, making it fully or partially immune to multiple forms of stalling. On some waves, it also spawns with various immunities, making it harder to kill. Due to a bug, '''Living Experiments''' with the [[Slime (Attribute)|Slime]] attribute do not spawn the [[Slime]] upon death. ==Appearance== The '''Living Experiment''' is a large humanoid with a waist, lower arms and lower legs in its rig. It has a light green skin color, and wears a tattered light blue hospital gown with a stitched seam going down the back, white bandages wrapped across its torso and metal plating with a glowing green piston on its back. It has a thin right arm with an armband with chains on it, as well as a large bionic arm with multiple glowing green pistons and a green glass container. It also has a large metal neck-guard with glowing green parts, as well as glowing green eyes, patches of black hair and a metal device with green lights and light brown stitch lines surrounding it on its head. It has a death animation, where it falls forward, with its bionic arm completely detaching in the process. The death animation is also accompanied by a sound, consisting of it grunting and metal thumping noises. ==Strategy== *Towers with decent DPS, like the [[Minigunner]], [[Militant]] or [[Cowboy]] are recommended against this. *On its debut wave, the '''Living Experiment''' is surrounded by a hordes of [[Armored]] and [[Slow]]s, which can be incredibly problematic. **Area of effect towers like the [[Pyromancer]], [[Rocketeer]], or [[Mortar]] can excel at clearing out the hordes, allowing DPS towers to focus on the '''Living Experiment''' itself. ***Some of them like the [[Rocketeer]] and [[Mortar]] also have sufficient DPS to deal with the '''Living Experiment''' itself on their own. *As the '''Living Experiment''' has [[Defense]], you can use [[Defense]] bypassing towers like the [[Trapper]] or [[Military Base]] to deal with this. **As these towers also have AOE attacks, they can be also used to deal with the hordes of enemies it usually spawns with. *Defense dropping towers, like the [[Pyromancer]] or [[Freezer]] can be used to reduce its defense, allowing your towers to deal more damage to it. *While the '''Living Experiment''' does not have any immunities to crowd control by default, it is a large enemy, making certain forms of stalling like freeze or knockback less effective on it. ==Sounds== {{Sounds|{{pe| {| class{{=}}"article-table align-center" style{{=}}"width:750px; margin:0 auto;" |- !
